- Main Interface (Fish Tank): F/Enter to feed, G to switch food, N to select a fish, T for treats, C to clean, L for lights, P to pop gold bubbles with a laser, R to tease the crab; plus K for the Bestiary, V for the Gene Lab, M for mini-games, E for expeditions, B for the shop, Q for quests, A for relics, W for weather, S for settings, and H for help.
- Deep-Sea Expedition (Submarine): WASD to move, Space for sonar, F for harpoon, G for EMP, Enter to interact/dock/rescue, M for the map, N for the mini-map, Esc to pause, and Q for an emergency ascent—plus a reminder regarding oxygen levels and bounties.
- Mini-games: Specific controls for Pearl Hunt, Reef Dash, Crab Battle (3×3 key layout), and Coral Echo.
- Menus / Shop / Bestiary: Use ; and . to select, , and / to switch tabs, Enter to confirm or purchase (press twice to sell), and B/Esc to go back.![图片](https://file:///C:/Users/Xian/Downloads/%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E_%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87.png)

- Chinese Pinyin IME: 6763 single characters + 5000 phrases, polyphone whitelist, 100 candidates, one-key CJK/ASCII punctuation toggle
- WiFi upload: browser-based TXT upload with chunked transfer; bookmark import/export
- Bilingual UI (Chinese / English)

## Hardware & Installation

- Target: M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3, no PSRAM)
- SD card via SPI: SCK 40 / MISO 39 / MOSI 14 / CS 12, 25MHz
- Partition scheme: **Huge APP (3MB)**
- Firmware size: ~1.5MB, flashable via M5Burner or esptool

## Known Limitations

- Polyphonic phrases use the first reading; some phrases (e.g. 重庆) need to be typed character by character
- Dash uses `－－` instead of standard U+2014
- Filenames starting with `.` are rejected on rename
